decisions.reason: Outer PlayerMagicProvider binding/serialization dispatch is support for known owned synced-spell disk reader and filtered death transfer, not a new independent mechanism. MagicData mana/cooldown/recast children are not all claimed previously covered; scoped followup candidates remain unreviewed, never inherited credit.
actual_chain: Registered MAGIC_DATA builder creates server-bound MagicData for ServerPlayer, otherwise new MagicData() default isMobfalse. Read provider instead uses new MagicData(true) for non-ServerPlayer, then loads NBT. This asymmetry is source observation, no runtime failure asserted.
MagicData(ServerPlayer) binds player and PlayerRecasts; synced spell data lazily binds same player. Save mana truncates float toint; load directly assigns int, bypassing setMana event/max clamp.

Outer load checks cooldown/recast raw ListTag casts, invokes respective child loaders if nonempty, then actual getSyncedData().loadNBTData. Wrong-type raw cast can throw. Empty/absent child lists do not invoke clear in this local method. Deep child implementations not counted/read here.

SyncedSpellData pair mixes casting/heartstop/evasion temporary fields with learned spell and selection; saved evasion float is read withgetInt. Existing accepted family retains this mixed-lifetime boundary; not a new reference.

Attachment MAGIC_DATA registration does not call copyOnDeath; explicit ServerPlayerEvents.onPlayerCloned gates death and ServerPlayer, copies SummonTimer effects, filtered persistent synced learned selection and cooldown entries. That known explicit Clone chain remains1existing, not whole MagicData copy.

decisions.reason: WerewolfPlayer.Serializer player-holder guard + constructor + delegated aggregate load is outer support for existing form-inventory and level-progress owners. No independent new owner/consumer is established merely by wrapper. Unread Vampirism superclass/SkillHandler/ActionHandler/customization not counted or considered completed.
actual_chain: Factory and Serializer require holder instanceof Player, bind new WerewolfPlayer(player), otherwise throw descriptive IllegalArgumentException. ModAttachments registers builder Factory+Serializer+copyOnDeath. Engine semantics/order of copyOnDeath not read or runtime accepted.

Constructor binds superclass toactualplayer, initializes owner-specific ActionHandler/SkillHandler, LevelHandler and WerewolfInventory. Aggregate reader delegates superclass, inventory,skills,actions,level,customization then reads lastFormAction/biteTicks/transformationTime.

Inventory child is existing full stack/form-slot reader; level child owns progress and real canLevelUp compares required XP/currentmax, so wrapper reconstruction is support for existing actual child owners. Level requirements config and skill/action consumers not fully traced here.

Writer stores form and lastFormAction conditionally, transformationTime asdouble; local disk reader has no explicit form read and usesgetFloat for transformationTime. Network deserializeUpdateNBT differs and calls switchForm(form) with current field rather than parsed string. Do not substitute network reader for disk restore or claim native persisted transformation succeeds.

scope_limits: Zero credit for outer binding wrappers, field count, metadata hashes or support sources.9actual Git blobs verified only for provenance.

Closing these exact wrapper candidates does not complete either entire mod, every player state or any Dynasty task. Unread nested state remains eligible only through independent later full gameplay-chain semantic research.
No upstream execution, native attachment engine/Clone order testing, game/Java/compile, original saves/assets/sharedJar edits or TODO deletions.
Source-only negative observations are not production fixes and do not authorize relevant changes before1000.
application_to_dynasty: Treat owner binding, disk restoration and death transfer as separate policies. Do not broad-copy mixed-lifetime aggregate payload or use attachment wrapper registration as proof that paid quest/reward state survives death. Preserve current audited whitelist boundaries.
